thumbnails.scene: An apartment hallway in warm lamp light. The Geek stands holding a mug and glances back over his shoulder with a flat, knowing deadpan look. Right behind his heels the silver tabby cat sits upright, staring up at him intently, tail curled around its white paws.

thumbnails.text: WHY IS IT ALWAYS BEHIND ME?
thumbnails.scene: A side view of The Geek walking down a hallway carrying a laundry basket, and the silver tabby cat trotting right at his heels, ringed tail held straight up like a flag, its white front paw lifted at the same moment as his sneaker. Warm afternoon light across the wooden floor.

The Geek sits at a desk in front of an open laptop, glancing sideways with a flat deadpan expression at the silver tabby cat, which sits upright on the desk right next to the laptop, staring at him from very close, ears forward. Soft afternoon window light.

The Geek stands in the doorway of a small bathroom with one hand on the half-closed door, looking down with a flat, defeated deadpan expression. The silver tabby cat sits squarely on the threshold at his feet, looking straight up at him, ears forward, clearly not leaving.
